visible_to_adjudicator: frozen canonical Alpha taxonomy (alpha_id, name_en, core_thesis)
never_visible_to_adjudicator: historical expected labels for the same sample
exclusion_rule: A non-null ambiguity_flag excludes that sample from the accepted scoring population, exactly as established for the development set.

replacement_rule.source: the remaining untouched reserve samples, in their already-frozen reserve order
replacement_rule.verification_method: Counted directly from docs/audit_artifacts/v0_2_alpha_dev_replacement_log.json (18 distinct reserve sample_ids consumed across round 1 + round 2), not assumed.

sequencing_requirement: Final Gold labels must be frozen BEFORE Candidate 3 is executed on the final set -- this task prepares the blind packet only and performs no adjudication and no Candidate 3 execution.
taxonomy_reference_note: Uses the exact existing canonical alpha_taxonomy_v1.yaml core_thesis definitions verbatim, unmodified. No taxonomy wording change.
